spring1901_aus_press.txt is the exact SYSTEM + blank line + USER text that the
unchanged oorexx_diplomacy v0.1-dev7r1 DiplomacyPlayer rendered for Austria's
first 1901 Spring press call (designer prompt "Play well.", rules text "RULES
TEXT"). Captured with a recording engine; the tests splice prompts, mail,
results and memory into it so every case starts from the framework's own text.
